name: GhostFileUpload
description: Headless file picker with a removable File[] list. Browse and drop share one intake path that checks accept, maxFileSize, validate, and capacity in input order, appends accepted files, and reports each rejected file with a typed reason. Optional form participation through a visually hidden file input mirror (name, form, required, reset). Outcomes are announced through a polite live region. Client-side checks are UX, not a security control; consumers own uploads.

props.name: accept
props.description: Native `accept` grammar: a picker hint that is also enforced on intake.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled seed and form-reset baseline, captured once at setup.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the trigger, drops, and remove buttons, and omits the mirror from submit.

props.name: form
props.description: `form` attribute for the mirror and the picker.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the trigger (the labelable control), not of the root element.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Consumer validity, combined with native constraint failure.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Total list capacity. Floored; not finite or below 1 is unlimited. `1` turns `multiple` off.

props.name: maxFileSize
props.description: Per-file limit in bytes; equal is accepted. Not finite or negative is unset.

props.name: messages
props.description: Typed, reactive overrides of announcement and label text.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled list. `undefined` is uncontrolled; `[]` is a real empty value.

props.name: name
props.description: Form mirror `name`. Without it no mirror renders and nothing is submitted.

props.name: preventDocumentDrop
props.description: Cancel file drags and drops outside every dropzone while an enabled dropzone is mounted.

props.name: required
props.description: Native `required` on the form mirror when `name` is set.

props.name: validate
props.description: Synchronous, pure check after `accept` and `maxFileSize`; return a string to reject.

models.description: v-model for the File[] list. Every change emits a new array with the same File instances; the consumer array is never mutated.

events.name: reject
events.description: Once per intake batch with at least one rejection, after update:modelValue. Fires even when a controlled parent ignores the list update.

slots.name: default

props.name: clear
props.description: Empties the list and `rejections`, and announces it.

props.name: clearRejections
props.description: Empties `rejections` without touching the list.

props.name: entries
props.description: Current list with stable ids for `v-for` keys.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Effective invalid state: `invalid` prop or native constraint failure.

props.name: openPicker
props.description: Opens the native picker. No-op when disabled.

props.name: rejections
props.description: Rejections from the most recent intake only.

props.name: remaining
props.description: `maxFiles` minus list length, never below 0; `undefined` when unlimited.

props.name: remove
props.description: Removes the first identical entry and applies the focus rule.

slots.description: Consumer layout of the parts, with the list entries, rejections from the latest intake, remaining capacity, effective invalid state, and actions.

exposed.name: openPicker
exposed.description: Opens the native picker; call inside a user gesture.

parts.name: root
parts.description: State owner element (div). Internal picker, form-input mirror, and announcer are not styling hooks.

states.name: invalid
states.description: invalid prop or native required failure from the mirror. Wins over disabled.
